profile_text: As a specialist in property management, this Düsseldorf-based firm provides tailored services for residential and commercial properties, catering to the unique needs of each client. With a stable workforce of 10 employees in 2024, the company has maintained its size since the baseline period, earning its classification as a Gazelle due to its steady presence in the market. Its focus on personalized property management solutions has enabled it to establish a strong reputation in the German real estate sector.
